Name: Archaeology Skill for 1.6
Author: MoonSlime
Description:
[size=3][center][/center][/size][left][size=3]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/3qxSqCb.png[/img]
[/size][size=3]Go level up a new skill as you dig up Artifact spots! 
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Gain EXP from Artifact spots, clay spots, digging something up in the mines, cracking geodes, donating to the muesem, or from panning[/size]
[*][size=3]As you level up, gain access to (currently) two displays. You can put artifacts on these displays through the Preservation Chamber machine (learned at level 1). Artifacts on display sell for a lot more than those that aren't! These display times selling price is affected by the new "Treasure Appraisal Guide" from 1.6![/size]
[*][size=3]At level 2 you unlock the grinding. Similar to the bonemill, you can turn rusty metal artifacts into ore. Or pure gold ones into ore. There are a few things you can shove into the grinder, so experiment![/size]
[*][size=3]At level 4 you unlock the soil sifter. Put in clay or stone and get artifacts back based on the machine's location.[/size]
[*][size=3]At level 8, you unlock the water sifter. Place in the water like a crab pot and you can get ore from it![/size]
[*][size=3]Choose professions that increase gold gained from selling artifacts, speed boost when digging up artifacts, or even be able to pan for artifacts![/size]
[*][size=3]Two new food items that buff Archaeology![/size]
[*][size=3]Cross-Mod Gift Tastes for every item in the mod (Note, most NPCs hate these things!)[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LGFY8Nd.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Level 5: Pioneer - More artifact spots have a chance to spawn each day.[list]
[*]Level 10: Antiquarian - When you dig up an artifact spot, chance for a  bonus item.
[*]Level 10: Curator - When you sell an artifact that is on display, it is worth more (stacks with the 1.6 book that triples artifact price)
[/list]
[*]Level 5: Drowser - Panning spots will spawn more frequently.[list]
[*]Level 10: Dredger - Gain additional items when panning, including artifacts.
[*]Level 10: 49er - When you get an item from panning or from digging an artifact spot, you get a speed boost. Duration of the speed boost is based off your level.
[/list]
[/list][/size][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2tjtjDL.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Alternative skill page icon: Changes the skill page icon from a shovel to a brush on a rock. Requires a restart to reload the skill
[*]Bigger Panning Arrow: Changes the tracking arrow for the Dowser profession to be larger.
[*]EXP gained from Digging: Change how much EXP you get from digging up an item! Default: 10
[*]EXP gained from Digging in the mines: Change how much EXP you get while in the mines! Default: 5
[*]EXP gained from the water shifter: Default: 5
[*]EXP gained from Panning: 10
[*]EXP gained from Donating: 50
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eg7jJbF.png[/img]
[list]
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/174]All Professions[/url]: All custom skill professions should be compatible with All professions.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]: All artifacts (and a rusty chest) can be put on displays. Extra artifacts from digging there should work as well.﻿
[*]Sunberry Village: All artifacts can be put on displays
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded: all artifacts can be put on displays.
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿: With the switch to content patcher, all items should correctly show up with the item patcher.
[*]Mastery (vanilla mastery): Archaeology does not have any mastery, but exp gained from Archaeology will contribute to mastery levels after the player unlocks it.﻿
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/Annosz/UIInfoSuite2/releases]UI infosuite 2[/url]: Does not support custom skills, you will not see custom skill exp gained from it. Please use one of the other options below...[/size].
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11089]Xp Display[/url]: Will show custom archaeology gained exp. This mod also has custom hooks into it's API to make it so the Hoe and Pan count as Archaeology tools.﻿
[*]﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22751]Abilities - Experience Bars[/url]﻿: Will show custom skills exp gain and show them as bars.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/509]Experience Bars[/url]﻿: Should be compatible with all custom skills
[/list][/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dMGE7uv.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Mastery
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NaNmbIk.png[/img]
[list]
[*]If you want to help out with making the skill better, please do! I am also looking to commission people for the following things (tho if you just want to help, that is also fine)
[/list][list=1]
[*]Improve the base code/optimizations
[/list][list]
[*]You can find the [url=https://github.com/Pet-Slime/StardewValley/tree/master/ExcavationSkill]github here[/url]﻿ to open pull requests
[/list]
[/size] [i][size=5][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/SkgptFd.png[/img][/size][/size][/i]
[size=3]Install required mods[i].
[/i]Download, unzip, and place the ArchaeologySkill folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.
If installed on an existing file, the new professions should be immediately available.[/size]
Should be compatible with most other mods.  Please share incompatible mods on Nexus.
Not compatible with Android.
